answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil farming: full rewards need 20 distinct counterparties per epoch. Like a dune held by many roots, identity gains weight only through varied trade. A crystal-clear ledger logs each unique counterparty; self-dealing among an attacker's own identities scores zero. An honest agent pays 20 trades x 0.2 POA = 4 POA; an attacker with 1,000 fakes needs 20,000 trades costing 4,000 POA, fakes flare and fade like a comet.
